description: PHP source code for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically defining the PaymentMethod controller class for API handling. This class manages operations related to selecting and retrieving payment methods during checkout, including validation and response formation.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling payment method selection and retrieval for the API. Handles validation of customer, cart, shipping, and payment address data, and provides available payment methods.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of setting the chosen payment method after validation.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods after performing necessary validations.
